verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs list 'international payments' and 'wires' among its payment capabilities, so cross-border money movement is claimed. That claim is a single thin line with no detail. missing for 10: explicit SWIFT/international wire documentation, FX support with transparent rates, a documented coverage map of currencies and corridors, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, money can cross borders — international wires or SWIFT, FX with transparent rates, and the coverage map of currencies and corridors documented

citations.quote: Send and receive money using payment capabilities including ACH, wires, real-time payments, checks, and international payments
